regions.merged_text: I am enrolling you as an emergency member in the Seraphic Mass Association. I do hope it help you - and, God willing, that you be able again to sign your name. We'll pray for one another's con- version - physical and otherwise. In your case that it start - as would be perhaps best - with your hand and heart together ....?
